title: A Simple Task
summary: Transport a fragile flower and draw out the Master Courier in the garden.
overview: Transport a fragile flower and draw out the Master Courier in the garden.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Minimize time carrying the flower and coordinate garden kills as a group.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: The flower decays while held by clients in the zone; its first decay is reached after roughly thirty seconds of accumulated time.
The decay counter is shared and advances faster when multiple tracked flowers are present. Zoning out pauses a carried flower's contribution.
Forty-one non-pet kills west of the garden boundary summon the Master Courier.
Plan the planting route before picking up the flower.

notes: Approval E360. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
